name: Jeremy Gulson
story: Jeremy Gulson is documented in operational geospatial work spanning the Canterbury rebuild and national transport. LINZ’s 2012 schools programme identified him as a Senior Spatial Consultant for SCIRT. In 2021 Waka Kotahi recorded him as Geospatial Manager and Manager Business Intelligence Direction presenting its multi-modal network framework, including routable networks, digital-twin potential, the One Network Framework and the Asset Management Data Standard.
LINZ names Jeremy Gulson in its geospatial virtual field-trip record: Senior Spatial Consultant, SCIRT, 2012 VFT.
